【中国粉面几大派·第2集 武汉热干面】这碗面最反常识的地方——一滴汤都没有。它靠拌不靠泡：碱水面煮到八分熟就捞起，掸凉、淋油，隔夜也不坨。灵魂是那一大勺芝麻酱，趁热拌开，每根面都裹得金亮。老字号蔡林记始于1928年，2011年制作技艺列入湖北省级非物质文化遗产。在武汉，吃早餐有个专门的词，叫"过早"——一碗热干面，就是这座城市清晨的烟火气。

Wuhan hot-dry noodles break the rule: not a single drop of soup. They're tossed, not soaked — alkaline noodles pulled at 80%, fanned cool and oiled so they never clump. The soul is a big spoon of sesame paste, tossed through while hot until every strand glows. The old house Cai Lin Ji dates to 1928; in 2011 its craft entered Hubei's provincial intangible-heritage list. Here, breakfast has its own word — guo-zao — and this bowl is the city waking up.

AI-assisted edit; the bilingual subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Facts checked this run; sources below. Food culture, not dietary advice. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
